title: The rug's corner
logline: Box 4B, holding down the corner of a rug that curls. Sixty pages of SLASH inside. The editor's foot beside it, in a boot. The page gives the box the whole floor.

panels.composition: The garage floor, low: a worn rug's corner curling, and a cardboard box on it holding it flat, the lid marked 4B, and beside the box a woman's boot and the hem of a dark green coat. Nothing else of her.

characters.pose: a boot and a coat hem

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a garage floor seen low with a worn rug's curling corner held flat by a cardboard box marked 4B in marker, a woman's boot and the hem of a dark green coat beside it, no words
image.notes: Letter after: 4B. The editor's strip (ro_2026-10-14) is three days on.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run

notes: Box 4B doing its job. The editor's boot.
